description:
Reid Kielder 3 | Carbon fork gravel bike
Lightweight, refined and built for adventure – the ideal performance gravel bike for exploring new trails, tackling demanding terrain and taking on everything from fast commutes to multi-day bikepacking journeys.
The Reid Bikes Kielder 3 builds on the success of its predecessors with refined geometry, a sleek new frame and upgraded components designed to deliver a more capable and enjoyable gravel riding experience. Combining a lightweight aluminium frame with a full carbon fork and Shimano CUES drop-bar groupset, it's built for riders who want to go further, ride harder and explore beyond the tarmac.
Its custom aluminium frame features a redesigned tubeset and gravel-focused geometry to provide a confident, balanced riding position across varied terrain. A full carbon fork helps reduce weight and improve front-end responsiveness, while internal headset cable routing gives the bike a clean, streamlined appearance. With generous mounting options for accessories and equipment, the Kielder 3 from Reid Bikes is equally suited to everyday commuting, forest trails and longer bikepacking adventures.
The Shimano CUES drop-bar groupset combines ergonomic hydraulic brake levers with smooth, dependable shifting, helping you maintain comfort and control over long days in the saddle. The hydraulic braking system provides responsive stopping power and precise control, while the lever design offers a comfortable hand position for extended rides.
Rolling on 45mm WTB Riddler tyres, the Kielder 3 delivers dependable grip across gravel, dirt and rougher trails while remaining fast-rolling on paved surfaces. The tubeless-ready tyres offer the option to upgrade to a tubeless setup, while the wider 25mm internal rim width provides a supportive platform. Increased frame and fork clearance allows for tyres up to 50mm wide, giving you the flexibility to prioritise extra comfort and traction on more demanding routes, with room for mud to clear.
With its upgraded groupset, refined frame design and adventure-ready versatility, the Reid Kielder 3 is built to perform across a wide range of riding conditions. Whether you're commuting through town, escaping into the forest or planning a multi-day expedition, it's ready to help you discover new routes with confidence.
The Reid Bikes Kielder 3 is ideal for:

Performance gravel riding, with refined geometry and a lightweight frame designed for confident handling across mixed terrain

Off-road exploration, with 45mm WTB Riddler tyres offering grip and control on gravel, dirt and rough trails

Long-distance adventures, with ergonomic Shimano CUES hydraulic levers designed to provide comfort and control over extended rides

Confident, responsive braking, with Shimano CUES hydraulic disc brakes for controlled stopping across changing conditions

Riders seeking a premium lightweight setup, with a full carbon fork and sleek aluminium frame

Commuting and everyday cycling, with versatile handling and mounting options for practical accessories

Bikepacking and multi-day trips, with frame mounting points for carrying luggage and essential equipment

Riders wanting greater tyre versatility, with clearance for tyres up to 50mm wide and 25mm internal-width rims

Tubeless gravel setups, with 45mm tubeless-ready WTB Riddler tyres for riders looking to explore tubeless options

Cyclists ready to explore further, combining quality components, refined design and versatile performance for road and off-road adventures
